> [!CAUTION] > Some comments are outside the diff and can’t be posted inline due to GitHub limitations. > > **⚠️ Outside diff range comments (1)** > >
> Major · Allow the OIDC settings in the override allowlist. · orbit-env.sh:22
>
>
>
> > `lib/orbit-env.sh:22` > ** Major** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** > > **Allow the OIDC settings in the override allowlist.** > > Orbit 0.4.0 reads OpenID Connect sign-in only from `ORBIT_OIDC_ISSUER`, `ORBIT_OIDC_CLIENT_ID`, `ORBIT_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET` and `ORBIT_OIDC_DISPLAY_NAME`. The package accepts operator settings only from `/app/data/orbit.env`. `orbit_override_allowed` lists only the upload, jobs and rate-limit keys, so `orbit_load_overrides` skips every `ORBIT_OIDC_*` line with a warning. `orbit_export_env` also unsets inherited `ORBIT_*` variables in server mode, so the environment offers no other path. An operator cannot enable the sign-in method that the 0.1.2 CHANGELOG entry advertises. > > This file is unchanged by the PR. OIDC is new in 0.4.0, so the upgrade makes this gap operator-facing. > > Add the four OIDC settings to `orbit_override_allowed`. This file is outside the file scope of issue `#19`, so the change needs authorization under the release policy or a follow-up PR. > >
> Suggested fix >
>
>
> > ```diff > - ORBIT_UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_BYTES | ORBIT_UPLOAD_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES | ORBIT_JOBS_CONCURRENCY | ORBIT_RATE_LIMIT_*) > + ORBIT_UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_BYTES | ORBIT_UPLOAD_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES | ORBIT_JOBS_CONCURRENCY | ORBIT_RATE_LIMIT_* | \ > + ORBIT_OIDC_ISSUER | ORBIT_OIDC_CLIENT_ID | ORBIT_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET | ORBIT_OIDC_DISPLAY_NAME) > ``` > >
